claims.claim_text: The IRS announced that Direct File would become permanent and projected average filing-cost savings of $150 per user.
Democrats would finance President Biden's proposed middle- and low-income tax cuts by making very wealthy people and large corporations pay what the party considers their fair share.
The platform says U.S. billionaires' average 8 percent tax rate is far lower than the rate paid by a firefighter or teacher.
Democrats would impose a 25 percent minimum income-tax rate on billionaires.
That billionaire minimum tax is projected to raise $500 billion over ten years.
